items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'I know Sherrie' and the interviewee responds about the band 'Diva' but does not explicitly state a personal relationship with Sherrie, only that Sherrie is associated with the project.

ctx.x: We’re talk — let’s talk about Diva for a minute. I know Sherrie and it’s been quite an amazing project.

Twenty-five — let me see — it’s over thirty years I think by now. It’s been a really important band. I think it brought a number of people in from other countries that were able to get Visas because of it, and it’s given a lot of women experience that they wouldn’t have gotten otherwise, and created a lot of long term friendships. A lot of people have come through that band.
